description: This Java source file defines a BackupAgent subclass called MultiRecordExampleAgent for backing up and restoring application data in an Android environment. It manages multiple discrete backup records identified by keys, allowing individual data items to be updated independently during backup and restore operations.

classes.name: MultiRecordExampleAgent
classes.description: A BackupAgent implementation that stores each piece of application data as a separate record for more granular backup and restore operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the agent by caching the application's data file location.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Handles the backup process, writing only changed data records, and updating the backup state.

methods.name: writeStateFile
methods.description: Writes the current data state to the backup tracking file.

methods.name: writeBackupEntity
methods.description: Writes individual data records to the backup data stream with associated keys.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Restores data from backup records and updates the application data file accordingly.
